articles.title: ‘A Song of Ice and Fire’ turns 30, official cast portrait from ‘The Mad King’
articles.description: Character portraits released for Game Of Thrones: The Mad King https://t.co/CXAMMRGfFR pic.twitter.com/7ah8aSXDoE — WhatsOnStage (@WhatsOnStage) August 1, 2026 An official look at the cast of ‘Game of Thrones: The Mad King’ has been released. The play is currently in previews. Left to right, the portrait includes Tanisha Spring as Ashara Dayne, Elizabeth Ayodele as Princess Elia Martell, Mariah Gayle as Queen Rhaella Targaryen, Callum Woodhouse as Lord Robert Baratheon, Michael Shaeffer as King Aerys II Targaryen, Harmony Rose-Bremner as Lyanna Stark, Luke Brady as Brandon Stark, Noah Ritter as Prince Rhaegar Targaryen and Michael Abubakar as Eddard Stark. The play is an adaptation of the books focusing on Tourney at Harrenhal and Robert's Rebellion. The play is adapted by Duncan Macmillan and directed by Dominic Cooke; George R.R. Martin collaborated with Macmillan and shared some new lore but the play is not strictly canon. There are some fairly controversial revelations in the play and spoilers are online. In related news the first book in the series ‘A Game of Thrones’ was released thirty years ago today on August 1, 1996. 30 years ago today, author George R.R. Martin released ‘A GAME OF THRONES’, the first novel in the ‘A SONG OF ICE AND FIRE’ fantasy series. What began as a single book grew into one of the most influential franchises in modern entertainment. pic.twitter.com/LdSKqr3au4 — westerosies (@westerosies) August 1, 2026 Twitter 2
